summary: Fort Technology Inc., a Toronto-based foreign private issuer (Nasdaq: FRTT, TSXV: FORT), filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the TSX Venture Exchange approved its voluntary delisting of common shares from the TSXV, the Canadian equivalent of a voluntary exchange delisting. Trading is expected to cease on the TSXV on or about November 6, 2026, while the Nasdaq Capital Market listing and FRTT symbol continue unaffected. The board attributed the move to insufficient TSXV trading volume relative to dual-listing costs and a desire to centralize liquidity on Nasdaq; no advisor or fee was named. Watch Canadian-holder brokerage mechanics and any volume shift post-migration.
